description: A React component module for the Network tab in a trace viewer UI, including model hook, rendering logic, and utilities for displaying network request data within a trace visualization project.

classes.name: ContextIdMap
classes.description: Manages generating and caching context identifiers for trace resources based on page references and API request contexts.

methods.name: useNetworkTabModel
methods.description: Custom React hook for creating and updating the network tab model based on trace data and selected time boundaries.

methods.name: NetworkTab
methods.description: Main React component rendering the network requests table, filters, and details view depending on user interactions and state.

methods.name: renderEntry
methods.description: Constructs a RenderedEntry object from a resource Entry, enriching data for display purposes.

methods.name: formatRouteStatus
methods.description: Determines textual status string for a network resource request based on its flags.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts an array of RenderedEntry objects according to the selected sorting criteria.

methods.name: comparator
methods.description: Provides comparison functions for sorting by various columns.

methods.name: visibleColumns
methods.description: Determines which columns to display in the grid based on selection state.

methods.name: allColumns
methods.description: Returns the default list of columns for the network requests grid.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders cell content for a given entry and column in the grid.
